notes: Bhishma Parva tenth day. Pitamaha as warrior grandsire (silver-white armor, NOT saffron sage). Shikhandi is a Panchala warrior on the field. No gore: bed of arrows as composed palanquin of shafts. No Drona.

bhishma.face: Ancient Kuru grandsire, noble lined face, long white beard (warrior, not sage)
bhishma.hair: Long white hair, Kuru diadem — no saffron topknot of a guru
bhishma.costume: Silver-white armor, pale cream dhoti, bow of the grandsire, no saffron robes

arjuna.face: Noble young warrior prince, dark mustache, same face as Ep 09
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti, gold belt, quiver on back, Gandiva — never flower garland

shikhandi.face: Young Panchala warrior, determined, no mustache or light, distinct from Arjuna
shikhandi.hair: Dark hair, simple warrior topknot, no gold crown
shikhandi.costume: Teal-green Panchala armor, shield and spear or bow — field warrior, not a princess gown

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dark eyes, serene

armies.costume: Muted banners, equal human scale, no gore
